title: Apple and Apricot Crumble
ldInstructionsRaw: Peel and core the apples and cut them into cubes. Arrange in a single layer in a round baking dish suitable for serving. Chop the apricots into small pieces and distribute over the apples. Sprinkle the fruit with 2 Tbsp. sugar.

Mix the softened butter with the remaining sugar (1/2 cup), the flour and a dash of cinnamon to form a crumbly dough. Cover the apples and apricots with the crumble. Bake in the preheated oven for around 20 minutes. Serve warm.
